segments.title: Chương 127: 0127 [Đối Thủ Mới: 5Q Campus Network]
segments.content:
Chapter 130 0127 A New Competitor: 5Q Campus Net (Bonus chapter for the Alliance Leader "Yaoshen Yibian")

To acquire a company, you can't just rely on information gathered online.

After arriving in Jingcheng, Zhou Yahui headed straight for Mop's headquarters to see Liu Jian.

Zhou Yahui and Liu Jian were both co-founders of Qianxiang Interactive.

After Qianxiang Interactive acquired Mop, Liu Jian was transferred over to optimize Mop's framework and community operations.

"There's no way to check Xiaonei Wang's data," Liu Jian said, shaking his head repeatedly. "It's just a small company founded a few months ago, and they don't have any external advertising business. Any data we have is what they've released themselves. If they don't release it, outsiders can only guess."

Zhou Yahui asked, "How much do you know about this company?"

Liu Jian said, "Not much, I just know they have a lot of momentum. And the campus belle competition they're holding has a huge influence in Jingcheng's major universities."

"What valuation do you think Chen Guiliang would accept?" Zhou Yahui asked again.

Liu Jian didn't answer directly, but smiled and said, "The guy's a Peking University student. Even if he were clueless, wouldn't he know to ask his professors? What's more, he can consult the project managers at the Peking University Incubator. None of those project managers are fools."

"I'm asking you," Zhou Yahui said.

Liu Jian said, "At least 3 million US dollars. If Xiaonei Wang isn't short on cash right now, they might reject investment and continue to develop, waiting until the valuation is over 10 million US dollars. Because their momentum is just too strong. They have no competitors, and their user base is growing organically every day."

The next day.

A member of Mop's management, dressed in a suit and tie, arrived at the Peking University Science Park building.

He asked for directions to the third floor and started wandering around, feigning nonchalance.

He walked to the outside of ByteDance's office and peeked in, trying to figure out the number of employees the company had.

"Can I help you find someone?"

An employee at a desk near the door asked.

The man replied, "I'm a Peking University alumnus, just came back from the US, thinking about starting a business here. I'm just looking around. Is your boss in?"

"He's not, he went to a book signing," the employee said.

"A book signing?"

"Yeah, our boss is an author."

"How many people are in your company?"

"There are 12 people in total for both companies, and we all work together. It's the weekend today, so some colleagues didn't come in. By the way, if you're a returning student entrepreneur, you should look for office space upstairs. The third floor is all for companies started by current students and faculty."

"I just got back to the country, and I've already heard about your Xiaonei Wang. How many registered users do you have now?"

"We broke 100,000 half a month ago. I'm not sure what the number is now. What kind of company are you planning to start?"

"High-tech medical devices."

"Then you'll be a high-end tech enterprise."

In reality, there weren't many secrets to leak. This deal was never going to happen.

That afternoon.

Zhou Yahui called his boss, Chen Yizhou, "Xiaonei Wang's registered users surpassed 100,000 half a month ago. Their model leads to very fast growth. Chen Guiliang is at a book signing today. I went to see it in person. There were several thousand people lined up for his autograph. He'll probably use his author's royalties to keep funding the company, so it's unlikely he'll accept outside investment in the short term."

"Then come back. We'll make a similar website ourselves," Chen Yizhou said.

Zhou Yahui asked, "Aren't we going to try and make contact?"

Chen Yizhou said, "Let's not tip them off. We'll work overtime to build the website, and as soon as university students are back on campus, we'll immediately invest in on-the-ground promotion. He's running his in Jingcheng, so we'll run ours in Modu."

Even if Chen Guiliang were willing to sell Xiaonei Wang for 10 million US dollars, Chen Yizhou didn't have that much capital to acquire it right now.

He had just acquired Mop a few months ago and was still pouring money into it!

Zhou Yahui immediately flew back to Jiangcheng and assembled a core team to create a similar website.

They wanted to register "Xiaoyuan Wang," but it was a generic name and couldn't be registered under trademark law.

So, they changed it to "Xiaoyou Wang."

By this time, the Trademark Office had established a partial electronic search system. Although it wasn't comprehensive and updates lagged, internet-related trademarks were still quite easy to check.

"Xiaoyou Wang has already been registered, half a year ago," the staff member informed them.

"Can you check for similar trademarks? Like Tongxue Wang or something."

"Tongxue Wang has also been registered."

This was, of course, Chen Guiliang's doing!

The upper management at Qianxiang Interactive discussed for days, but couldn't come up with a name that could compare to Xiaonei Wang.

The name was very important!

Xiaoyoulu, they had already used that one, and it was now a website under Sohu.

Xiaoyuan Wang, Xiaoyou Wang, and Tongxue Wang were all unavailable.

It wasn't until the website's framework was already built that Chen Yizhou finally came up with a name and announced, "We'll call it 5Q Xiaoyuan Wang. 5Q represents IQ, EQ, AQ, CQ, and SQ. It's also an English acronym for Quick, Quality, Quest, Share, and Question. This will be the operating philosophy of our 5Q Xiaoyuan Wang!"

Zhou Yahui mulled it over. It didn't feel that great.

Xiaonei Wang was simple and direct. You knew what it was just by hearing the name.

5Q Xiaoyuan Wang had a bit of a knock-off feel to it, making it seem like some sketchy website that had popped out of nowhere.

But Zhou Yahui couldn't think of a better name, so he could only go along with Chen Yizhou's wishes.

As for the various features of 5Q Xiaoyuan Wang, they just copied Xiaonei Wang. Their advantage was having sufficient funds. They could advertise on all sorts of websites and send out a large team for on-the-ground promotion.

Jingcheng, at night.

The two companies, ByteDance and Game Science, with their 12 employees in total, plus Chen Guiliang and Bian Guanyue, were having their year-end dinner together at a small restaurant.

*Those Things in the Ming Dynasty* had been on sale for half a month, with cumulative sales of 146,000 copies. This was slightly higher than Guo Xiaosi's *Lost in the Flowers of a Dream*, but it included pre-sale data from Dangdang.

The *Legends of the Three Kingdoms* bookmark included with each book had surprisingly attracted many readers to download the game.

The homepage banner ad for *Legends of the Three Kingdoms* on 17173.com had long been taken down, but the recommended spot ad was still up.

Coupled with traffic from other online channels, there were now 190,000 registered users, with about 45,000 daily active users, and a peak concurrent player count exceeding 10,000.

The payment conversion rate was temporarily only 3.5%.

But this was affected by the New Year's event. Many veteran players' free memberships hadn't expired yet from participating in the event, and they hadn't used up the items they had accumulated back then.

Chen Guiliang raised his glass to everyone, "We didn't make any money this year, so I can only treat you all to hotpot. But the speed of the company's growth is plain for all to see. When the company gets big, everyone here will be a founding member, and I will definitely show my appreciation then. Talking like this feels a bit like making empty promises, so a year-end bonus is more practical."

"Come to the office tomorrow to get your year-end bonuses. Everyone gets one. The amount will differ slightly based on your start date and work performance. I hope that next year, everyone's bonus will double, and then double again!"

"Cheers!"

"Cheers!"

Everyone stood up and clinked their glasses, their moods quite excited.

Just as Chen Guiliang had said, the company was developing exceptionally fast, and everyone was full of expectations for the next year.

Xie Yang had long since become a full-time employee. His current salary was 1,800, and he was mainly responsible for promoting *Legends of the Three Kingdoms* and Xiaonei Wang. Don't think it's too low; this was a salary beyond his personal capabilities. If it weren't for his outstanding performance with the Tieba forums, some people in the company might have started gossiping.

Xie Yang understood this very well and was cramming knowledge of communication studies every day. He also planned to self-study management books next year.

Ao Yanchen took out four tickets, "Here are your train tickets. I've already bought them."

Of the company's 12 employees, only four were going home for the New Year: Dong Qianqiu, Cai Yifei, Zhu Xia, and Gong Chunyan.

Gong Chunyan was the newly hired cashier.

The rather pretty Gong Xiaozhen, however, was a Jingcheng local, though she lived far from Peking University, in a rural suburban area of the city.

Everyone was tipsy as they helped each other back to their dorms.
